seo.title: Garanti BBVA: Ugi genAI assistant - 60 million conversations in one year (2025)
seo.meta_description: Garanti BBVA's Ugi assistant, migrated to an LLM, assisted more than 5 million customers and held more than 60 million conversations in one year.
seo.resume_citable: Ugi, the assistant in Garanti BBVA's mobile app migrated to an LLM infrastructure, assisted more than 5 million customers and held more than 60 million conversations in one year, understands 90% of requests, and covers more than 300 end-to-end banking transactions.

faq.q: What can Garanti BBVA's Ugi assistant do?
faq.a: Ugi executes end-to-end banking operations in the mobile app: card requests, card payments, card passwords, transfers, and information requests, while understanding 90% of requests.
Over one year, Garanti BBVA reports more than 5 million customers assisted and more than 60 million conversations, with on average more than 6.4 million interactions per month in 2026.

objectif_business: Handle most customer requests in self-service within the app (card requests, card payments, transfers, card passwords, information) and absorb the daily volume away from costly channels, by pushing a conversational experience that anticipates needs.
description: Ugi is the assistant built into the mobile app of Garanti BBVA, BBVA's Turkish subsidiary. Launched in 2016 as a rules-based chatbot, it has been migrated to a large language model infrastructure, which lets it track the context of a conversation and anticipate the customer's needs. The customer talks to Ugi in natural language to carry out operations: a credit or debit card request, a card payment, a card-password transaction, a transfer, or an information request. In the twelve months before the April 2025 release, Ugi assisted more than 5 million customers and held more than 60 million conversations. The May 2026 release (the service's tenth anniversary) states that it understands 90% of requests, covers more than 300 end-to-end operations, has 1.6 million active users, and handles on average more than 6.4 million interactions per month.
points_cles: Ugi, the assistant in the Garanti BBVA mobile app, moves from a rules engine to an LLM infrastructure.
Over one year: more than 5 million customers assisted and more than 60 million conversations.
Understands 90% of requests and covers more than 300 end-to-end banking transactions.
Level B evidence, two consistent official releases; live status confirmed (the service's tenth anniversary, May 2026).

resultats.metrique: Customers assisted over one year (as of April 2025)
Conversations held over one year (as of April 2025)

niveau_preuve.justification: Figures self-reported by Garanti BBVA in two consistent official releases over more than a year (the genAI upgrade of April 2025; the service's tenth anniversary in May 2026), redistributed by a press wire. Primary sources from the subject brand, with no third-party vendor bias, but not tied to a financial disclosure: hence a B rather than an A.

stack_technique.detail: The mobile app assistant, initially rules-based, migrated to an LLM infrastructure that enables context tracking and anticipation of needs. The sources do not name a specific third-party model.
Ugi's channel, integrated with accounts and banking operations in real time.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time, 24/7, in the mobile app; proactive notifications pushed continuously
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Garanti BBVA's digital and data team, in-house
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The intent the customer expresses in natural language, plus the account and transaction signals that feed the anticipation of needs. Without up-to-date account data and an intent history for continuous learning, understanding and proactivity degrade.

etapes.detail: The customer states their request in natural language in the app (card request, payment, transfer, card password, information).
The LLM engine interprets the intent and follows the thread of the conversation; it understands 90% of requests.
Ugi carries out the banking operation end to end among more than 300 covered transactions, drawing on account data.
Outside of requests, Ugi anticipates needs and pushes instant personalized notifications.
The in-house team uses transactions and user feedback to widen the scope handled and fix poorly understood cases.

prerequis_data: Real-time account, card, and transaction data
A history of customer intents for training and continuous learning
A reference of banking operations eligible for self-service
prerequis_orga: A dedicated digital and data team over time
A banking security and compliance framework for the operations executed
Governance of proactive notifications (frequency, relevance, consent)
stack_possible: A large language model with context tracking
An orchestration layer linking the understood intent to the execution of operations
Deep integration with the core banking system and the mobile app
replication.equipe: A digital product team (PM, conversational design), NLP/LLM engineers and MLOps profiles, with banking security and compliance involved throughout.
replication.premiere_etape: Start from an existing rules-based assistant or conversational FAQ, map the most requested operations, then migrate understanding to an LLM before opening up transactional execution.

playbook.action: Map the most frequent operations and requests in the app from support logs and customer journeys.
playbook.livrable: A reference of intents and operations prioritized by volume.

playbook.action: Migrate the understanding layer from a rules engine to an LLM able to track context, in a test environment.
playbook.livrable: A read-only genAI assistant, tested on real data.

playbook.action: Connect end-to-end transactional execution for a first batch of operations, with security and compliance sign-off.
playbook.livrable: An assistant able to execute a subset of operations in beta.

playbook.action: Widen the scope to sensitive operations (transfers, cards, passwords) and add anticipation and proactive notifications.
playbook.livrable: A generalized assistant covering a broad catalog of operations.

playbook.action: Set up continuous learning on transactions and feedback to improve the understanding rate.
playbook.livrable: A continuous improvement loop in production.

statut_vivant.note: The May 2026 release (Ugi's tenth anniversary) confirms the service is in production and growing: 90% of requests understood, more than 300 operations covered, 1.6 million active users, more than 6.4 million monthly interactions. No sign of withdrawal.

transposable_ue.note: Deployed in Turkey, outside the EU. An assistant that reads accounts and executes operations (transfers, payments, card requests) requires, in the EU, a clear GDPR legal basis and, under the AI Act, a transparency obligation about the AI nature of the counterpart. The pattern is transposable; the data architecture and compliance have to be rebuilt.
